product.title: Cortech Solstice - Behavioral Health Bed - One‑Piece Rotationally Molded Design - Models 100 / 100S3
product.body_html:
The Cortech Solstice Bed merges unparalleled strength and durability with a more familiar, home-like design to enhance patient comfort and security. Depending on the environment, it can be bolted to the floor or weighted with sand through optional underside ballast doors.

  • Durable, one-piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength
  • Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene
  • Molded-in, raised head and footboards to prevent mattresses from sliding
  • Designed for use with a 36” x 75” mattress
  • Optional underside ballast doors (3 doors) for adding weight with sandbags (sandbags sold separately, loose sand not recommended) - order model 100S3
  • Option to bolt to the floor via concealed pilot holes and hardware of your choice
  • Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
  • GREENGUARD Gold Certified
  • Noise Generation Test RAL-AN23-010 conclude half as many decibels produced in comparison to steel
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133)
  • Test reports available upon request
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA
  • 10-Year Factory Warranty
  • Patent Pending

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
